text:
samir: dropping a very small prototype for the first-run flow — two variants: (A) full checklist left + sample tray right, (B) single-column with collapsible checklist above samples. Need quick feedback on readability, perceived complexity, and microcopy.

holly: Variant B feels less intimidating. The left-rail checklist in A dominates the viewport on 1366x768. Can we make checklist collapsed by default and show summaries instead?

ines: +1 for collapsed-by-default. Also, sample card headlines are inconsistent \"AI Assistant\" vs \"Support Bot\". We should standardize to user-facing titles and a 1-line intent.

ux-bot: Note: telemetry event names in prototype currently use mixed casing (e.g., onboard.SampleClick). Standardize to snake_case: onboard.sample_click.

marc-a11y: accessibility quick notes: 1) ensure cards are reachable via keyboard grid navigation (tab into tray, arrow keys move between cards), 2) all CTAs must be >=4.5:1 on background, 3) collapsed checklist state should still expose controls to screen readers (use aria-expanded + aria-controls).

ravi: Microcopy nit: checklist header currently reads "Onboarding checklist (optional)" 6 I'd prefer "Recommended setup steps" — less hedging. Also consider a short helper line: "Complete these to finish your first demo."

holly: CTA labels: some cards say "Open demo", others "Launch". Recommend verb-first: "Try demo" or "Launch demo". Consistency helps analytics too.

ines: Mobile layout: horizontal sample scroller is awkward for thumb reach. Suggest stacked cards with full-width CTA for <420px.

samir: Implementation constraints: we want to lazy-load sample assets; avoid heavy images on initial mount. Use blurred placeholders + progressive load. Also track visible-card impressions only when >50% in viewport.

marc-a11y: For keyboard users, ensure visible focus ring token appears on card focus. Current mock hides outline. Also ARIA: when a new sample is selected announce title with aria-live polite.

ux-bot: AB test plan idea: variant 1 (collapsed checklist) vs variant 2 (expanded checklist). Primary metric: onboard.sample_try rate within 10 minutes. Secondary: time-to-first-API-call.

ravi: Copy candidates for the hero line: A) "Start with an example project" B) "Try a curated demo to get running fast" C) "Pick a sample and launch a demo app" Which is clearest?

holly: I like B — feels action-oriented but clear. Maybe tweak to "Try a curated demo and get running fast."

ines: Also flag: some sample cards show an estimated time label (e.g., "~2 minutes"). Good idea but ensure punctuation and singular/plural: use "~2 minutes to run" or "About 2 minutes".

samir: Action list from this thread: 1) standardize sample titles + add 1-line intent; 2) adopt collapsed-checklist default for quickstart path; 3) mobile uses stacked full-width cards; 4) unify CTA copy to "Try demo" and update analytics to onboard.sample_try; 5) ensure contrast >=4.5:1 and visible focus ring; 6) implement keyboard arrow navigation + aria-live announcements; 7) lazy-load images and impression threshold at 50%. I'll push updated frames and a small prototype link by EOD.

marc-a11y: I'll draft a 6-point accessibility QA (contrast, keyboard nav, screen-reader announce, aria-expanded, focus ring, focus order) and attach to PR template.

ux-bot: Reminder scheduled: design sync 2006007900 for sign-off.

holly: thanks all — if samir posts the prototype, I'll run a quick 5-person usability pass tomorrow morning.:coffee:
